description: This PHP source file defines the `Daux` class within the `Todaymade\Daux` namespace, which appears to be a core component of a documentation generation system. The class manages configuration, content tree generation, content type handling, processor integration, and output operations, serving as the main orchestrator for generating documentation in various formats.

classes.name: Daux
classes.description: Main class responsible for configuration, content tree management, format generation, content type handling, and command-line output within the documentation generation system.

methods.name: generateTree
methods.description: Generates and builds the documentation content tree, applying configuration settings, multilingual adjustments, and tree manipulation.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration object, setting up the tree if not already done.

methods.name: getProcessor
methods.description: Returns the processor instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: setProcessor
methods.description: Sets a custom processor instance and updates the configuration accordingly.

methods.name: getGenerators
methods.description: Returns a list of available generators, extending defaults with processor-provided generators.

methods.name: getProcessorClass
methods.description: Determines the class name of the processor based on configuration, verifying class existence and inheritance.

methods.name: findAlternatives
methods.description: Finds approximate matches for a given input within a list of words using Levenshtein distance.

methods.name: getGenerator
methods.description: Creates and returns the appropriate code generator object based on configuration, with error handling for invalid formats.

methods.name: getContentTypeHandler
methods.description: Returns the content type handler, combining base and extended content types.

methods.name: getContentExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of valid content file extensions supported.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Static method returning the output object, defaulting to NullOutput if none set.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Static method to write messages to output, optionally with newline and options.

methods.name: writeln
methods.description: Static method to write messages with a trailing newline.

methods.name: getVerbosity
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the current output verbosity level.
